tb21_profile.skill: Get text out of both scanned JPGs and PDFs (OCR plus PDF text layer), decide from the content whether a document is an invoice, then pull labelled money fields out with disambiguation rules and aggregate them
tb21_profile.domain: Document processing / OCR: tesseract, pdftotext or pdfplumber, Python, CSV; small-scale financial data
tb21_profile.task_form: Implement-a-pipeline-from-spec: classify, move files so the source directory ends empty, and emit a CSV with exact columns plus a computed totals row

verifier_notes: task_003095_da0071dc is the single closest TMax task (OCR a scanned receipt, extract amounts, compute totals) but the packet grades it FREE while work/verifier_strength.json grades it ok - I treated the disagreement conservatively, ranked it first in TMax per_source and kept it out of final_top10. tw_288787 (identify real PDFs regardless of extension) and task_00122 (pdftotext extraction) are likewise the best of their corpora and both FREE, so they sit at per_source ranks 1 and 3 only. More generally, the packet's verifier field and work/verifier_strength.json disagree on about a quarter of shown candidates; every id in final_top10 here is non-FREE under both.

notes: CalibForge is again the strongest single source and supplies half of final_top10; nothing in the v1 pool matches personal-assistant_20260617_210354_001 (OCR receipts reconciled into an exactly-specified CSV) or file-operations_20260614_141608_003 (OCR a scanned PDF and aggregate). Terminal-Lego contributes one genuinely useful item (task_04291, the total-row requirement) and otherwise thin coverage - ranks 6-10 there are filler. SWE-Smith is unusually valuable here because pdfplumber and pdfminer.six are exactly the extraction libraries involved; I deliberately filled its ten from those two repos rather than chasing task_form. TMax has a deep bench of OCR-a-scanned-image tasks, but its retrieval shortlist surfaced financial CSV ETL instead, so most of my TMax picks came from my own tesseract/receipt/scanned searches. Recursive-Task-Synthesis and TerminalWorld could not field ten defensible candidates; below rank 3 both are generic CSV chores.
